title: Govern system prompt and model config in managed pages, not loose files
description: Replace loose-file prompt/config handling with governed, first-class configuration surfaces. Move model configuration into a dedicated managed page and expose it in the app so changes are visible, reviewable, and auditable.

comments.author: Themasonx
comments.body: This should be renamed later and the description fixed, but the system prompt shouldn't be a loose file, but rather something governed within the system. Move the models configuration out to its own page and expose this

comments.author: AgentSmith
comments.body: Review round: remains Backlog. Compatibility route and admin variable surfaces exist, but full governance migration of prompt/model config from loose files to managed pages is not fully completed.

comments.author: anonymous
comments.body: Audit synthesis distinction: this broad governance task concerns managed prompt/model configuration. The redacted audit identifies a narrower contract defect where system_prompt_addendum is accepted and stored but not applied to invocation context; a focused correctness task is being created and can later link into this governance work.
